Welcome, lanista. This is a sandbox league made for this lesson — nothing is saved. Up top: your treasury (we lent you plenty), fame, ludus grade, record and the week's lanista's hours.
The tabs run your ludus — your house, the arena, the wider world, and you. Work them left to right each week; the coach will walk you through them.
Open 🛡 Roster — the fighters under contract to your house.
You have two fighters. Click {0} in the list to open their card beside it.
The card: rating, morale, loyalty, contract. Under Keeping them you spend hours and coin to keep a fighter happy and loyal. Click 🍷 Share a meal with {0}.
Morale and loyalty rise. Morale walks onto the sand with them (80+ adds AP and CF); loyalty is what a rival must beat to poach them.
Now 🤝 Recruiting — the free agents of the empire.
Click any free agent in the list to open their recruiting card.
Courting starts with knowing them. Press Scout — six sparring bouts in your ludus reveal what they want and how they grade your house.
Now pitch them — sell what they care about most (the grades you just revealed). One pitch per recruit a week; each costs an hour.
Their interest climbs as you court them — feasts, pitches, a famous house, a fair wage. When it is high enough, Offer a contract. Not today: we have a card to fight.
{0} came home hurt last week. Open the ⚕ Infirmary.
A hurt fighter cannot be entered. Call the Medicus for {0} — it clears the wound and lifts their spirits.
Cleared for play. Now 🏛 Your ludus — where coin and points become a better house.
Open 🏗 Facilities: permanent upgrades — one project a week.

Build the 🐎 Stables — your own road crew makes every away trip cheaper. (The yard, the infirmary wing, the barracks, the armory and the practice stands each help in their own way; together they set your Ludus grade, which recruits look at.)
Coin builds the house; perk points build you. Open 🎓 Schooling.
Spend your perk point on any trait — Honor, Showmanship, Discipline… Recruits grade you on exactly these. You earn more each week: wins, kept pledges, training.
The weekly drills live in the 🏋 Training Yard tab (with sparring against other stables). This tile takes you there any week.
The heart of it: ⚔️ Match Week.

Each week's games are in one city — and in that week you can walk its city square: shops, the tavern, the auction block, the crowd. Explore it in your own career (after paying the road, away from home). Not in this lesson.
Pick {0} in the Undercard's list and press Enter your fighter.
Now watch {0} fight — 👁 Watch it live from your box, or 🎟 Spectate from a seat in the stands.
The bout is live on the sand (close the briefing first — it tells you the event's rules). You could watch it to the end; for the lesson, press ⏭ Sim to end to resolve it now.
The result is in. Press ⏎ Return to Match Week.
A verdict awaits for {0}: the Fate table sent them to the Thumb of Flavius. Face it — roll the d6 yourself.
The Feature bout. You do have a fighter who could go in — {0} — but we are saving them for the Main event. So bet on this one instead: raise your stake with +5.
Now press Bet beside the lit fighter — the bookmaker's favourite (the lowest odds).
Slip in hand. The card runs in order — press ⚡ Simulate on the Feature bout to fight it now. (You could also watch it or fight it yourself.)
The Main event — the big purse. Pick {0} and press Enter your fighter.

Now ⚡ Simulate Match Week — the main event is fought in a moment, with {0} in it. (In your own career you can also watch it live or fight it yourself — take your fighter's reins on the sand. For the lesson, we simulate.)
Another verdict from the main event — settle it the same way before the week can end.
📊 League — the table. A win is 3 points, a runner-up finish 1; the top four go to the Superbus at season's end.
Every house can be visited. Click {0}{1}.

Their lanista, roster and ledger — and correspondence. Send an envoy: 🎁 gifts warm a rival (trades and pacts need a warm opinion).
🌍 Imperium — the map of the empire.
Fans on the roads, weather, wars and plagues, each city's crowd and mood — all of it moves attendance, purses and risk. A war can even call your fighters to the levy.
📅 Season — the schedule.
Twelve weeks, a city each week; festivals and invitationals on the side; the Superbus in Roma at the end. Plan your roads and your stars around it.
Last: ⏭ End the week. Wages are paid, the yard trains, rivals scheme — and the empire moves on.
